title: AI for green multi-cluster: Intelligent management towards green and low-carbon, large-scale multi-clusters
summary: TeleAI describes reinforcement-learning scheduling and LLM assistance for computing clusters. Its reported GPU-availability gains come from virtualization and resource sharing.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The system uses learned scheduling, including reinforcement-learning agents and LLM explanations, to improve computing-resource allocation. Its reported 150% increase in GPU availability comes from virtualization and resource sharing. Improvements in AI-assisted scheduling and energy use remain intended, with no measured gain attributed to those functions.
purpose: Use learned scheduling and model-generated assistance to improve cluster resource decisions.
system: AI for green multi-cluster: Intelligent management towards green and low-carbon, large-scale multi-clusters
developer: Institute of Artificial Intelligence (TeleAI), China Telecom

ratings.reason: Improved AI scheduling is intended. The reported 150% GPU-availability gain comes from virtualization and resource sharing.
Lower emissions from AI-assisted scheduling are intended; no attributable carbon reduction is reported.

ai_role.statement: Reinforcement-learning agents learn scheduling policies; LLMs are intended to explain or assist scheduling decisions.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 8: AI for green multi-cluster: Intelligent management towards green and low-carbon, large-scale multi-clusters

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: AI scheduling research targets greener computing clusters
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
